title: Physical scientific environment qualification
objective: Qualify the actual Windows workstation, WSL2 runtime, GPU, storage, recovery behaviour, antivirus compatibility and instrument-connected site where applicable.
software_automation: System probe, disk/RAM/GPU inventory, large-file integrity, recovery probe, immutable report and target-machine boundary checks.
external_evidence_required: ('Target Windows machine report', 'GPU/driver report where applicable', 'Antivirus, sleep/resume and network-loss results', 'Instrument/site IQ-OQ-PQ and calibration records where applicable')
completion_rule: Every required physical-machine, GPU, site and instrument control must pass on the actual target environment.

title: Specialist engine installation and qualification
objective: Install and qualify every module-required scientific engine with pinned version, licence, executable hash and golden-fixture smoke test.
software_automation: Step 170 WSL2/micromamba provisioning, manual-provider intake, version capture, executable SHA-256, smoke tests and registry updates.
external_evidence_required: ('Installed executable or provider package', 'Licence acceptance', 'Version and executable SHA-256', 'Golden fixture and integration result')
completion_rule: All engines required by the module must be qualified in the Step 170 registry.

title: Production reference database qualification
objective: Acquire official production reference releases and verify release identity, licence, provider checksum, local SHA-256, schema, indexes and scientific review.
software_automation: Resumable download/import, checksum verification, licence gates, schema/index validation, rollback and release lifecycle registry.
external_evidence_required: ('Official provider release', 'Provider checksum and local SHA-256', 'Licence/permitted-use record', 'Schema, record-count and index validation', 'Scientific reviewer approval')
completion_rule: All references required by the module must be qualified in the Step 170 registry.

title: Authentic task-specific models and real cohorts
objective: Qualify task-matched model weights and real public, institutional or assay cohorts without synthetic or wrong-domain substitution.
software_automation: Step 171 model-card, cohort, feature-schema, environment-lock, licence and cryptographic artifact verification.
external_evidence_required: ('Authentic task-specific model artifact', 'Real cohort and metadata', 'Model card, training logs and environment lock', 'Model/cohort/feature SHA-256 records', 'Human-data authorization where applicable')
completion_rule: Applicable modules require both a full task-specific domain model and a real public/official cohort; non-model modules are not applicable.

title: Independent locked benchmark validation
objective: Run a pre-specified, checksum-locked and leakage-controlled evaluation on an untouched external site, temporal or study holdout.
software_automation: Locked split manifests, per-sample prediction export, calibration, uncertainty, subgroup, applicability-domain and baseline comparison checks.
external_evidence_required: ('Untouched independent holdout', 'Per-sample ground truth and predictions', 'Leakage and duplicate audit', 'Calibration and confidence intervals', 'Subgroup/applicability-domain analysis', 'Independent-site result')
completion_rule: Applicable model modules must pass every Step 171 benchmark control and independent external-site validation.

title: Wet-lab, prospective and orthogonal confirmation
objective: Confirm applicable module outputs using frozen protocols, blinded prospective execution, independent sites and orthogonal assays.
software_automation: Step 172 evidence workspaces, hash-bound manifests, batch/control checks, protocol freeze, blinded outcome reconciliation and fail-closed evaluation.
external_evidence_required: ('Locked protocol and acceptance thresholds', 'Raw evidence/data manifests', 'Wet-lab confirmation where required', 'Prospective confirmation where required', 'Orthogonal confirmation where required', 'Independent-site qualification')
completion_rule: Every confirmation axis required by the module profile must be complete with verified artifacts.

title: Independent expert sign-off
objective: Obtain qualified independent domain and QA review with conflict disclosure and cryptographically verifiable signatures.
software_automation: Credential, conflict, review, public-key and detached-signature verification using SHA-256/OpenSSL.
external_evidence_required: ('Expert credential artifact', 'Conflict-of-interest disclosure', 'Signed review report', 'Detached signature and public key', 'Explicit independent approval decision')
completion_rule: The Step 172 expert-signoff gate must meet the module minimum with cryptographically verified independent approvals.

title: Qualified real-world operating history
objective: Record enough genuine module runs, incidents, downtime, drift, recovery and corrective actions to demonstrate sustained operation.
software_automation: Append-only run ledger, incident/CAPA templates, drift review and immutable history report verification.
external_evidence_required: ('Minimum required qualified runs', 'Failure and downtime history', 'Incident and CAPA records', 'Drift review', 'Zero unresolved critical incidents')
completion_rule: The module-specific minimum operating-run count, drift review and critical-incident controls must pass.

title: Formal controlled-release review
objective: Approve the exact evidence snapshot through an independent QA, domain-expert and product-owner release committee.
software_automation: Quorum, intended-use, prohibited-use, residual-risk, signed decision, rollback and monitoring-plan verification.
external_evidence_required: ('Release committee quorum', 'Independent QA approval', 'Domain-expert approval', 'Product-owner approval', 'Intended/prohibited use and residual-risk acceptance', 'Signed release decision and SHA-256')
completion_rule: Formal release review and every upstream required gate must pass; averaging cannot override a failed gate.
